export DISPLAY=:0; python3 << 'EOF'
from PIL import Image
img = Image.open('/tmp/s1.png')
# Crop the menu area in detail - menu starts around y=30, ends around y=270 maybe
# Original image is 1920x1080
crop = img.crop((75, 80, 220, 280))
crop.save('/tmp/menu.png')
print(crop.size)
EOF

export DISPLAY=:0; python3 << 'EOF'
from PIL import Image
img = Image.open('/tmp/s1.png')
# Crop the full menu
crop = img.crop((75, 80, 250, 330))
crop.save('/tmp/menu2.png')
print(crop.size)
EOF

export DISPLAY=:0; python3 << 'EOF'
from PIL import Image
img = Image.open('/tmp/s1.png')
# Need to scale up to find Slide Pane - menu seems to extend further
crop = img.crop((75, 80, 270, 480))
crop = crop.resize((crop.size[0]*3, crop.size[1]*3))
crop.save('/tmp/menu3.png')
print(crop.size)
EOF
input.description: Crop and scale up View menu
